name: 老师备课
description: 从一个课题备好一节课：教学目标 → 教案和练习题（并行）→ 生成学生练习单和答案，并检查时间和目标覆盖。 / Prepare a lesson from a topic: objectives → lesson plan and exercises (in parallel) → a student worksheet and answer key, with a check on timing and objective coverage.

topic.description: 课题，例如：分数的初步认识 / The lesson topic, e.g. introduction to fractions

grade.description: 年级或学段 / Grade or level

minutes.description: 一节课几分钟 / Lesson length in minutes

language.description: 输出语言：zh 中文，en English / Output language: zh or en

stages.name: 教学目标
stages.description: 3 到 5 个可以检验的教学目标，以及重点和难点。 / 3 to 5 objectives you can check, plus the key point and the hard part.

stages.name: 教案
stages.description: 按环节写教案，每个环节标分钟数和对应的目标。 / Write the plan step by step, each step with its minutes and the objectives it serves.

stages.name: 练习题
stages.description: 从易到难的练习题和答案，每题对应一个目标，和教案并行。 / Exercises from easy to hard with answers, each tied to an objective, in parallel with the plan.

stages.name: 练习单
stages.description: 生成发给学生的练习单（不带答案）和老师用的答案，并检查时间加起来对不对、每个目标有没有讲到、有没有练到。 / Build the student worksheet (no answers) and the teacher's answer key, and check that the minutes add up and every objective is taught and practiced.
